newsitem.title: USA: Comcast to redeem 10 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Comcast to redeem 10 pct debentures.

text.p: Comcast Corp said Tuesday its subsidiary, Storer Communications Inc, will redeem all $139.3 million principal of its outstanding 10 percent subordinated debentures Due May 15, 2003.
The debentures, issued in 1983, will be redeemed on June 30, at face value plus the May interest payment, for a total payment of $1,012.50 per $1,000 principal amount.
The Debentures are listed on the American Stock Exchange under the symbol SCI.A.
Comcast Corp operates cable television and telephone services, cellular and personal communications services, satellite television and is also part-owner of QVC and E! Entertainment.
